ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a rectangular sheet of paper, with the bottom horizontal width labeled as 6 inches. On the right side there is a dashed vertical side and a bottom dashed line, indicating the original position of the lower-right corner of the rectangle; after folding, this lower-right corner falls to a certain point on the left side of the rectangle. The crease is a line segment slanting downward from the upper-right corner to a certain point on the bottom side, labeled with length L; the angle between this crease and the right-side vertical dashed line is labeled θ. Using the coordinate method, let the original lower-right corner be C=(6,0), the point after being folded to the left side be P=(0,p), and the upper-right corner be T=(6,H). The crease is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment CP connecting point C and its folded image P, so the crease passes through the midpoint M=(3,p/2) of CP and is perpendicular to CP. The slope of CP is (p-0)/(0-6)=-p/6, therefore the slope of the crease is 6/p. Also because the angle between the crease and the vertical direction is θ, the angle between the crease and the horizontal direction is 90°-θ, and the slope is cotθ. Therefore 6/p=cotθ, giving p=6tanθ. Point M lies on the crease passing through T. From M=(3,p/2) to T=(6,H), the horizontal change is 3, and the vertical change is H-p/2. The slope of the crease is cotθ, so (H-p/2)/3=cotθ, that is, H-p/2=3cotθ. Substituting p=6tanθ gives H=3cotθ+3tanθ=3/(sinθ cosθ). The crease L has angle θ with the vertical direction, and its vertical component is H, so H=Lcosθ. Therefore L=H/cosθ=3/(sinθ cos^2θ)=3sec^2θ cscθ.

raw_record.question_text: A rectangular piece of paper is 6 inches wide and is folded as shown so that one corner touches the opposite side. What is the length of the crease $L$ in terms of angle $\theta$?

method.method_draft: Coordinate/perpendicular-bisector route. First read the diagram: the original rectangle is 6 inches wide horizontally; the dotted vertical and dotted bottom indicate the original lower-right corner. The fold crease is the slanted segment of length L from the top-right corner to a point on the bottom edge, and it makes angle θ with the vertical dotted side. The folded lower-right corner lands on the left side of the rectangle. Let the original lower-right corner be C=(6,0), the landed point on the left side be P=(0,p), and the top-right point on the crease be T=(6,H). Because a fold crease is the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining a point to its folded image, the crease is perpendicular to CP and passes through the midpoint M=(3,p/2). Since CP has slope -p/6, the crease has slope 6/p. But the crease makes angle θ with the vertical, so its slope is cot θ; hence p=6 tan θ. Now use that M lies on the crease through T: moving from M to T has horizontal change 3, so 3=(H-p/2)tan θ. Substitute p=6tan θ to get H=3cot θ+3tan θ=3/(sinθ cosθ). Finally L is the hypotenuse of the right triangle formed by the crease with vertical component H, so L=H/cosθ=3sec^2θ cscθ.

按坐标法设原来的右下角为 C=(6,0)，折到左边后的点为 P=(0,p)，右上角为 T=(6,H)。折痕是点 C 与其折后像 P 的连线 CP 的垂直平分线，所以折痕经过 CP 的中点 M=(3,p/2)，并且垂直于 CP。

CP 的斜率为 (p-0)/(0-6)=-p/6，因此折痕斜率为 6/p。又因为折痕与竖直方向夹角为 θ，所以折痕与水平方向夹角为 90°-θ，斜率为 cotθ。因此 6/p=cotθ，得到 p=6tanθ。

点 M 在经过 T 的折痕上。从 M=(3,p/2) 到 T=(6,H) 的水平变化为 3，竖直变化为 H-p/2。折痕斜率为 cotθ，所以 (H-p/2)/3=cotθ，即 H-p/2=3cotθ。代入 p=6tanθ，得 H=3cotθ+3tanθ=3/(sinθ cosθ)。

折痕 L 与竖直方向夹角为 θ，其竖直分量为 H，所以 H=Lcosθ。因此 L=H/cosθ=3/(sinθ cos^2θ)=3sec^2θ cscθ。
